issues.description: The problem statement (part a) explicitly instructs the student to load the pixel value into ECX (mov ecx, [esi]). The provided solution, however, reads the pixel into EAX (mov eax, [esi]) and the surrounding push/pop sequence in main is inconsistent about which register holds the pixel value when printing. This mismatch between the described register to hold the pixel value and the solution's/register usage will confuse students about which register they must use for the initial pixel read and for printing, and may cause their implementation to appear incorrect despite following the textual instruction.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register usage consistent across problem, template, and solution. Either update the problem statement to instruct students to load the pixel into EAX (mov eax, [esi]) and clarify the expected register order for printf, or modify the solution (and any template example code) to load the pixel into ECX (mov ecx, [esi]) and ensure subsequent pushes for printf use ECX as the pixel value. Ensure the comments near the TODO and the printf push order agree with the chosen convention.
